description_en: Correct errors in search terms and titles
description_zh: 针对搜索词及标题进行纠错修改
kebab_example: aliyun aidge text-correct --source-text Empfelung --source-language de --region cn-hangzhou
name: TextCorrect

parameters.help_en: Source language code. Required. You can pass "auto" for automatic language detection. Supports 14 languages
parameters.help_zh: 源语种代码，必填。可传auto做语种识别，支持14个语向
parameters.name: source_language

Code.description_en: Response code. Returns "success" during normal calls
Code.description_zh: 响应代码，正常调用时返回"success"
Code.title_zh: 错误码，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。

UsageMap.description_en: Usage information, including the number of input characters
UsageMap.description_zh: 用量信息，包含输入字符数等
UsageMap.title_zh: 用量信息（key为用量名称，value为计数）

Message.description_en: Error message. Returns "Success" during normal calls. Returns specific error information during exceptions, such as "The parameters contain sensitive information. Please try a different input."
Message.description_zh: 报错信息。正常调用时返回"Success"，异常时返回具体错误信息，例如"参数中包含敏感信息，请尝试其他输入"
Message.title_zh: 错误信息，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。

RequestId.description_en: Request ID, used to identify a unique request call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用来识别唯一一次请求调用

Success.description_en: Whether the call was successful. true indicates success, false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 是否调用成功。true代表成功，false代表失败
Success.title_zh: 是否调用成功：true：调用成功。false：调用失败。
